description: This file provides user management services such as retrieving user information, creating users, authenticating users, managing roles, and mapping database rows to user dictionaries.

methods.name: dict _row_to_user_public(row: sqlite3.Row, roles: List[str])
methods.description: Maps a database row and roles list to a public user dictionary.

methods.name: Optional[sqlite3.Row] get_user_by_email(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves user data from the database by email.

methods.name: Optional[sqlite3.Row] get_user_by_public_id(conn: sqlite3.Connection, public_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves user data from the database by public ID.

methods.name: List[str] get_user_roles(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches roles assigned to a user by user ID.

methods.name: int ensure_role_exists(conn: sqlite3.Connection, role_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a role exists, creates it if it does not, and returns its ID.

methods.name: None assign_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int, role_name: str)
methods.description: Assigns a role to a user by user ID.

methods.name: dict create_user( conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str, username: Optional[str], full_name: Optional[str], role_name: str, )
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified details and role, returning user info.

methods.name: Optional[dict] authenticate_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returning user info if successful.

ctags.name: assign_role
ctags.pattern: /^def assign_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int, role_name: str) -> None:$/

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^def authenticate_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> Optional[dict]:$/

ctags.name: create_user
ctags.signature: ( conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str, username: Optional[str], full_name: Optional[str], role_name: str, )
